item.title: Forma 1.5
item.description:
• Automatic updates with Sparkle (appcast on GitHub, EdDSA-signed notarized DMGs)
  • Prepare for distribution: MIT license, README, release script (signed + notarized DMG)
  • Forma 1.4–1.5: Drop uploads, window router, Dock/menu-bar presence
  • Forma 1.3: Finder menu, Share extension, background jobs, recipes
  • Forma 1.1–1.2: history & undo, preview, clipboard rules, menu bar panel, documents
  • Add AI upscale ×2 mode (Apple super-resolution on the Neural Engine)
  • Forma 1.0: native macOS converter & compressor (images, video, audio, PDF)
